scope: Stone, Bronze, Iron, Classical first release; desktop only
unpublishedIntegration: Natural conflict contextual capture/intact occupation/finite loot

method.weighting: equal gate weights; no time, effort, code-volume or feature-catalogue percentage implied
method.creditRule: 1 only for recorded executed evidence matching the gate scope; pending/unverified/partial=0
method.baselineRule: Verified narrow behavior refers to published c25f405-or-earlier evidence. This does not certify the current unpublished working tree. Regressions revoke credit; new integration gates remain pending until matching acceptance and publication.
method.scopeChanges: Do not silently add/remove/split easy gates to improve percentages. Any requirement change creates a documented new baseline version and recalculated denominator.
method.updateRule: After every finished batch and push, update actual evidence/status, recalculate counts and report verified/total and percent; report batch delta and published commit separately. Failed push is not published.
method.evidenceRule: Source files/test definitions and design briefs alone are not proof of passed execution; older narrow scenarios are not generalized to current connected campaign.
